headline: A local group has sued to halt construction of Nebius's data centre in Independence, Missouri, with a hearing set for 22 October.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a lawsuit with a hearing set; no ruling yet, and the allegations are the plaintiffs' claims.
importance_line: It matters to residents near Bly Road who want construction stopped and to the city, which approved billions in incentives, but the claims are allegations and no court has ruled on them.
summary: KSHB 41 Kansas City reports that a motions hearing is set for 22 Oct 2026 on a lawsuit by the Independence GUARD Alliance to halt construction of a 2.1-million-square-foot AI data centre that Nebius, a Dutch tech company, is building in Independence, Missouri. The lawsuit alleges the city broke zoning and sunshine laws and its charter, and Nebius says it is reviewing the claims and cannot comment on the case.
notes: KSHB 41 read in full; source is KSHB 41 Kansas City. Pool item FOX4KC blocked (403). Score 5 kept. The lawsuit was filed earlier in 2026; the hearing date is the news. Allegations are the plaintiffs' claims, not findings.
